bagPolicy.summary: Bags exceeding 10” x 6” x 2” are not permitted inside the Kaseya Center. Guests should adhere to the size restrictions for a smooth entry.
prohibited: Coolers, bottles, cans, or other containers
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Due to ongoing development, fewer parking options are available near Kaseya Center. Patrons are advised to consider alternative parking options with flat rates within walking distance. Public transportation is recommended.

rideshare.note: Uber/RideShare Drop-Off: At the corner of Bayshore Drive & HEAT Blvd. Use Gate 6 for entry.

concessions.note: Kaseya Center offers a diverse culinary experience with options ranging from chef-driven tacos and smashburgers to vegan street eats and Caribbean bowls. Special offerings include Game Day Value Menu and Family Meal Deals, providing affordable dining options for fans.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Both lounges are located at center court on the event level, beneath the bowl seating, and are accessible via private entrances from the P2 Garage and from street level Premium Entrances (Gate 4).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests will not be permitted to leave an event/game and re-enter the same event.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Reverse ATMs will also be located on-site (next to Box Office and in sections 109, 121, 318, Inside Gate 1A: Next to Miami HEAT Store) to convert your cash into a prepaid debit card. The Kaseya Center Ticket Office is located on NE 8th Street, between Gates 3 and 4.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: In general, doors open to public (1) hour prior to the printed event time.​
